convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh libraries (Expert.mqh, SignalCrossEMA.mqh, TrailingNone.mqh, MoneyFixedLot.mqh) for trading logic, signal generation, trailing, and money management. The core signal logic is encapsulated in CSignalCrossEMA class from an external library, not implemented inline.

other_exits: CExpert framework handles opposite signal close by default when signal reverses

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses Lots parameter as fixed lot size; Percent parameter is used for margin/free margin calculation within the fixed lot framework

custom_logic_notes: The Expert_EveryTick is set to false, meaning the EA processes signals only on new bar formation rather than every tick. The CExpert base class handles position management including closing opposite positions on signal reversal. No explicit SL/TP is set; exits rely solely on signal reversal. Magic number 14395 is hardcoded (not an input).
python_conversion_notes: This EA is a standard MQL5 Standard Library expert advisor. The CExpert/CSignalCrossEMA framework encapsulates all trading logic. For Python conversion: (1) implement two EMA indicators (periods 12 and 24), (2) detect crossover/crossunder on bar close, (3) enter market orders on signal at next bar open, (4) close opposite position on reversal signal, (5) use fixed 0.1 lot sizing. The CExpert framework's position check and new-bar guard behavior need to be replicated. No trailing stop or SL/TP logic needed. The Percent parameter in CMoneyFixedLot is not used for lot calculation in the standard library when Lots is specified.
